messages:
emily: Quick sync - proposing a "schema inspector lane" in Playground run history. Each tool call becomes a slim lane: header (fn name + type pill + time), collapsible body with structured view, and quick actions. Attaching compact mock. thoughts? raj: Nice. Two priority asks: 1) collapsed summary must be keyboard/readable by SRs, 2) streaming shouldn't spam narrators. taylor: Agree. Suggest header copy: 'getOrders() · Structured · 120ms' and a short subtitle when collapsed: 'Result: 3 orders (partial)'. Keep under 30 chars for i18n. kate: A11y: collapse must be a real button with aria-expanded + aria-controls. Lane container role=region, aria-labelledby points to header. For streaming mark aria-live="polite" but only announce completion. miriam: UX nit: add a tiny type pill [Structured] or [Text] so users glance type. Also quick actions: Copy JSON, Open schema, Expand path. Make actions tabbable. emily: On streaming UX: append lines visually, but don't auto-scroll if user focus/selection is inside. Show a "new" badge and a small scroll-to-bottom button. raj: For keyboard: left/right to switch lanes, Enter to toggle collapse, Tab to reach actions, Up/Down to move inside the structured tree. Add visible focus ring. taylor: For nested structured objects, breadcrumbs inside the lane header feel heavy. Instead, offer a small inline drill control at the top of the body: "path: orders[0] › items" that's keyboard navigable. Right arrow drills in, Left goes up. Announce current path to SRs. kate: Copy success must be announced: "JSON copied to clipboard" and show a transient tooltip. Also provide a keyboard shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+C) and ensure it's in docs. miriam: Performance note: lazy-render deep nodes and collapse long arrays by default with "Show more". Ensure screen readers can expand via keyboard. emily: I'll update Figma: header variants, aria snippet, and short/long copy options. Draft ARIA snippet for notes: ```html
\n \n getOrders() · Structured · 120ms\n \n
\n
\n``` raj: Perfect. I'll add keyboard e2e tests for lane focus order and streaming behavior. taylor: I'll prep short translations for DE/JA and test truncation. kate: I'll run a quick SR session to confirm the live-region announcements are not noisy. emily: Thanks all. Will push updated frames and ping when ready for round two. a11y-bot: Checklist: add aria-expanded tests, aria-live finalization only, focus order assertions, i18n length checks.
